issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with a return type of void, but the textual description specifies that it should return a String (format: LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)), and the solution implements it as returning String. This mismatch between the UML and the textual/specification & solution can mislead students about the correct method signature and cause them to implement the wrong return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML in the problem statement so getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() is declared to return String (e.g. +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String) to match the textual description and the solution. Alternatively, adjust the textual description to match the UML if the intention was to have a void method, but aligning UML with the described behavior (returning a String) is recommended.
